name: Raspberry
description: Raspberry (genus Rubus, subgenus Idaeobatus, primarily Rubus idaeus for red raspberry; Rubus occidentalis for black raspberry). Commercial fresh-market cultivars split into floricane (summer-fruiting, bearing on second-year canes) and primocane (fall-fruiting / everbearing, bearing on first-year canes), a distinction that drives pruning regime, harvest window and protected-culture suitability. Created as part of the multi-berry portability audit (2026-08-20) to give berry_ids a resolvable target for berry-raspberry, mirroring berry-blueberry's own record and the same previously-identified gap (schema-assessment.md A-3, proposed-schema-enhancements.md P-1) that had only been fixed for blueberry.
